# thiserror 2.0.20 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/thiserror (2026-08-08)
- docs: https://docs.rs/thiserror/latest/thiserror/
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0

`#[derive(Error, Debug)]` + `#[error("{0}")]` for usage/auth/not-found/conflict/network/generic variants. Exit codes are a method on the enum, not Display. Chosen over anyhow so tests can match `exit_code()` without stringly types.
